packages.angle: Bitcoin is the most undervalued asset because it is a global free market outside government control.

segments.label: hook
segments.text: Bitcoin imposes a global free market for the first time ever.

segments.label: clip_01
segments.text: I mean, the good news about Bitcoin is it's not, you know, its success is not dependent upon who's in the White House or who's controlling the Senate or the House of Representatives in the U.S. You know, price -wise, some people would say when it's when it's persecuted and when it's in the crosshairs, it tends to do pretty well.

segments.label: clip_02
segments.text: However, I think Bitcoin is by far the most undervalued asset in like the entire global financial system right now. So, you know, Bitcoin gold parity is around like $1.5, $1.4 million per Bitcoin last I checked. It's very, very undervalued.

bridges: What stands out is how rare it is for any asset to be priced by everyone and controlled by no one, which makes the usual political drama feel irrelevant.
